title: RegistrySnapshotManifest.v1
description: Immutable active A-F identity snapshot bound to one source baseline.
$comment: This document contains no registry_snapshot_id. The gate derives it as sha256:<SHA-256(UTF-8 JCS bytes)>. registry_state_preimage_id must resolve to a schema-valid RegistryStatePreimage.v1 whose self-hash suffix equals registry_state_sha256 and whose database snapshot, revision, parent, generation, identities, pointers, capacity, and last event exactly reproduce this snapshot. The gate must prove exactly one ACTIVE, VERIFIED identity for each A-F role, a common source_generation_id and parent task, authoritative thread_spawn evidence, and no provisional/orphan/lost identity in active_identities.

capability_receipt_ids.$comment: The gate requires at least one VERIFIED CAPABILITY receipt for each exact active identity and rejects receipts from another parent task, source generation, or instance revision.

capacity_contract.$comment: The gate enforces physical_instance_budget >= 6 * max_retained_source_generations + replacement_reserve, exact equality to the referenced CapacityCertification, and counts every active, retained, provisional, orphan, lost-visible, superseded-visible, close-requested, close-tool-completed, and replacement instance not proven PLATFORM_CLOSED.
